blocks.html:
The ask

Go from 4 campaigns a month to 8. Same list, same calendar, same approval batch. The only thing that changes is how many of the emails we've already planned actually get sent.

Why, in your own numbers

Over 52 weeks, May ’25 to Oct ’26, you sent one campaign in 40 ordinary weeks and two in 5. The one-send weeks earned $6,494. The two-send weeks earned $10,564. That's $4,070 more for one more email. The second send earns a little less on its own ($5,282 against $6,494), so there is some overlap, but it adds 81% of a campaign rather than splitting one in half.

Unsubscribes went the other way to what you'd expect. 0.29% at one a week, 0.22% at two. Your biggest week ever was Nov ’25: 5 campaigns, $35,727, and the lowest unsubscribe rate on the board at 0.19%. Sending more has never cost you a list.

blocks.html:
What it costs and what it returns

Extra campaigns a year48
What they cost at $300 each$14,400 · $1,200/mo
What they return at the rate above$195,358
At half that rate, to be safe$97,679
Return on the extra fee6.8× to 13.6×

For context, the 46 campaigns you ran in the last 12 months cost $13,800 and are credited with $306,783. That's 22 times the fee, at $6,669 a campaign. The eight doesn't need a new result to work. It needs the one you already get, more often.

What it asks of your team

  • No new approvals process. Same monthly batch, twice the emails in it.
  • No new assets. The calendar is already written and the concepts are already approved. They just aren't being sent.
  • No new platform cost. Your Klaviyo plan allows 280,000 emails a month. Eight campaigns uses about 125,000.
  • No commitment to fill it. 8 is a ceiling we're allowed to use, not a quota. If revenue per campaign or unsubscribes move the wrong way, we drop back and you've learned where your ceiling is.

52 weeks of your own campaigns, May ’25 to Oct ’26, grouped by how many went out that week. 7 offer weeks and 3 peak weeks are excluded, so the comparison is ordinary week against ordinary week and a sale can't inflate the step. A cadence is only quoted where you ran it at least three times. The 12-month totals are complete months, 2025-11 to 2026-10, in USD.

Revenue is Klaviyo's attribution on last click, which is the generous reading rather than the strict one. That's why the table quotes half the rate as well as the full one, and the proposal still works at half. A holdout test gives you the strict number and we'll run one if you want it.

reports.summary: Every week you sent twice instead of once earned $4,070 more, with fewer unsubscribes. Doubling to 8 a month costs $1,200 a month and is worth $97,679 to $195,358 a year.
